name: supabase
title: Supabase database (server-side)
summary: Postgres via Supabase's REST API from api/, a rate-limit ledger, and migration guard rails.
when: Anything must persist: form submissions, bookings, users, orders, content an admin edits. Server-side only; the browser never holds the service key.
env: # Server-side only (api/). NEVER prefix these with VITE_: the service-role
# key bypasses Row Level Security and must not reach a browser.
next: Create a Supabase project, then set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in .env (local) and in the Vercel project (Settings, Environment Variables).
Apply supabase/migrations/ in order (Supabase CLI `supabase db push`, or paste into the SQL editor).
Read packs/supabase/README.md 'The standing rule' before changing any table or function in production.
